licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (as read: gamemap.cc header lines 12-13; COPYING is GPL v2, June 1991)
target_module: origins/client/hud/minimap.ts (proposed path; not verified against the Frankendom repo)
best_idea: Bake each zone's minimap once from zone data by reducing each block type to one colour, then project the player's tile with a single scale and invert the same scale for click-to-travel.
decision_why: Zones are data, so a bake from block types keeps the minimap in step with them; the averaged ground tint is too coarse to show roads or buildings, so that layer is ours to add; the palette snap and the cheat-gated teleport are donor-era and not kept.
acceptance: A player opens the map and sees each zone block in its type colour with a plus on their own block; a server test asserts that tileToPixel then pixelToTile lands within one block (16 tiles) of the start for every tile of a zone, and that a map teleport is refused unless the server accepts the destination.
